subject.title: fix(anthropic): add claude-fable-5 to CLI allowlist, aliases, labels, and context window

question: Should Claude Fable 5 be exposed and seeded as a supported Claude CLI model through this broader canonical PR?
rationale: The implementation follows existing architecture and upstream behavior, but adding a provider model to selectable defaults and changing its session budget are product-facing provider decisions.

options.title: Accept broader support
options.body: Treat Claude Fable 5 as a supported Claude CLI model and merge this branch after normal exact-head gates.

options.title: Require authenticated turn
options.body: Ask for one subscription-backed configure and agent-turn proof before accepting the provider exposure.

options.title: Decline default exposure
options.body: Do not add Fable 5 to the default Claude CLI model set and close or narrow this branch.

recommendation.title: Accept broader support
recommendation.body: Treat Claude Fable 5 as a supported Claude CLI model and merge this branch after normal exact-head gates.
